# Core (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

What every feature uses: the database and schema, file paths, encryption, storage, live updates, file reading and the shared HTTP helpers.

## Files

- `context.ts`: Per-request context, so code deep in a transaction (the audit log) can see who the request came from without every caller passing it along.
- `crypto.ts`: Encrypts provider API keys at rest with AES-256-GCM.
- `db.ts`: Database adapter.
- `env.ts`: Loads ../../.env if it exists.
- `extract.ts`: Reads the text out of evidence and client documents so agents and search can use it: PDFs (with a text layer), Excel workbooks, Word documents, and plain text formats.
- `format.ts`: Small value formatters shared by the record mappers that turn database rows into API responses.
- `http.ts`: Shared helpers for route files: the async wrapper, the actor lookup and errors a person can see.
- `paths.ts`: Where the server finds files outside its own code: the repository root (for .env), the data folder (database, evidence, secret key) and the agents' rules files.
- `realtime.ts`: Live updates.
- `schema.sql`: The database schema, append-only: each version adds its changes at the end.
- `storage.ts`: Evidence file storage.
